video_title: BASIC PARAGLIDING EXERCISES - THEO DE BLIC's TUTORIALS

pitch_pendulum_uncaught.title: 1A. Pitch Pendulum — Single Pull & Uncaught Dive (How to Pitch)

events.description: Pilot initiates symmetrical brake pull from trim
Canopy reaches maximum aft pitch angle behind pilot (pendulum back-apex)
Pilot releases brakes briskly hands-up at aft pendulum apex
Canopy passes overhead (theta = 0 deg) accelerating into the forward dive
Canopy reaches maximum forward dive angle ahead of pilot

pitch_pendulum_active_catch.title: 1B. Pitch Pendulum — Resonance Double-Pump & Active Catch (Catching the Dive)

events.description: Pilot initiates symmetrical brake pull from trim
Canopy reaches maximum aft pitch angle behind pilot (pendulum back-apex)
Pilot releases brakes briskly hands-up at aft pendulum apex
Canopy passes overhead (theta = 0 deg) accelerating into the forward dive
Pilot applies symmetrical catch brake pulse while canopy dives ahead
Canopy reaches maximum forward dive angle ahead of pilot

pitch_mistake_late_brake_stall.title: 1C. Pitch Mistake — Re-Braking While Wing Pitches Aft (Risk of Stalling)

events.description: Pilot initiates symmetrical brake pull from trim
Canopy reaches maximum aft pitch angle behind pilot (pendulum back-apex)
